failure_condition: Activating Settings changes the visible panel but leaves aria-selected false.
interaction_steps: Inspect selected state and visible panel.
expected_outcome: The selected state reflects the active tab.
manual_verification_method: Operate tabs with keyboard and inspect selected state with a screen reader.
